sections.st: Switches, Sensors & Module Packaging Manufacturer India — ESD-Safe Thermoformed Trays, Bulk from Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures switches, sensors, and electronic module packaging from our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom ESD-safe thermoformed packaging for the complete range of electromechanical switches, proximity and temperature sensors, IoT modules, relay modules, and control electronics. ESD packaging OEM from Vapi Daman for switch manufacturers, sensor manufacturers, and electronic module producers across India and for export.

Switch and sensor packaging presents unique requirements not found in passive component or PCB packaging: actuation surface protection. Electromechanical switches have actuator buttons, levers, and toggle mechanisms that must not be pre-actuated or mechanically damaged by packaging contact. Proximity sensors have active face geometries that must be free from contamination and contact. IoT and relay modules have mounting headers and connector interfaces that require specific protection geometry.

sections.st: Three Problems Switches, Sensors & Module Packaging Buyers Face

strips.title: Pre-Actuated Switches — Assembly Failure at First Use
strips.desc: Problem: Electromechanical switches with actuator mechanisms pre-actuated by packaging pressure during transit fail at the first use test in assembly — the switch mechanism is in the wrong state and may be permanently damaged. Solution: Cavity geometry designed with actuator clearance — the switch actuator button, lever, or toggle is suspended in a clearance zone, cannot be pre-actuated by packaging contact.

strips.title: Active Sensing Face Contamination — Sensor Performance Degradation
strips.desc: Problem: Proximity sensor and optical sensor active faces contaminated by packaging material contact during transit show reduced sensing range and increased false trigger rate in service. Solution: Active sensing face clearance cavity — sensing face suspended in a defined clearance zone with no packaging contact.

strips.title: ESD Damage to Module Microcontrollers and ICs
strips.desc: Problem: IoT modules and relay modules contain microcontrollers, crystals, and ICs that are ESD-sensitive — ESD damage from non-ESD-safe packaging causes latent failures in module firmware execution and control logic. Solution: ESD-safe PP packaging for all electronic module packaging — CoA per batch confirms dissipative range.

sections.st: Switches, Sensors & Module Packaging — Key Design Requirements

strips.title: Actuator Clearance — Switch Mechanism Cannot Be Pre-Actuated
strips.desc: Actuator geometry (button height, lever travel, toggle sweep) confirmed from switch datasheet or physical sample before cavity design. Cavity provides actuator clearance in all positions — the switch cannot reach actuation state from packaging pressure under transit load. Confirmed from physical switch actuator test on prototype before production.

strips.title: Active Face Clearance — Sensing Surface Isolation
strips.desc: Proximity sensor and optical sensor active face dimensions confirmed from sensor datasheet before cavity design. Defined clearance zone over sensing face — no cavity wall contact on sensing surface. Particulate contamination path between cavity wall and sensing face minimised.

strips.title: ESD-Safe PP Throughout — Microcontroller and IC Protection
strips.desc: All electronic module packaging in ESD-safe PP — IoT modules, relay modules, and control electronics contain microcontrollers that are ESD-sensitive. Surface resistivity CoA per batch.

strips.title: Terminal and Header Protection — Mounting Interface Integrity
strips.desc: Through-hole header pins and PCB mounting terminals confirmed from module specification before cavity design. Terminal clearance geometry prevents pin deformation during transit and pallet stack loads.

faqs.q: What switches, sensors, and modules does Trizen manufacture packaging for?
faqs.a: ESD-safe packaging for SPDT/DPDT toggle switches, tactile push buttons, proximity sensors (inductive, capacitive), temperature and humidity sensors, IoT modules, relay modules, and industrial control modules. ESD-safe PP. ISO 9001:2015. ESD packaging OEM from Vapi.

faqs.q: What is actuator clearance in switch packaging?
faqs.a: Switch actuator (button, lever, toggle) geometry confirmed from switch datasheet or physical sample. Cavity provides clearance in all actuator positions — the switch cannot reach actuation state from packaging contact pressure. Confirmed on physical prototype before production tooling.

faqs.q: Why is active sensing face clearance required for proximity sensors?
faqs.a: Proximity sensor active faces contaminated by packaging contact show reduced sensing range and increased false trigger rate in service. Active face clearance cavity — no packaging contact on sensing surface, particulate contamination path minimised.

faqs.q: Why ESD-safe PP for IoT and relay modules?
faqs.a: IoT modules and relay modules contain microcontrollers, crystals, and ICs that sustain ESD damage at 10–30V. ESD-safe PP provides continuous charge dissipation — latent ESD damage prevention throughout the supply chain.
ESD packaging OEM manufacturer Vapi Daman. Electronic component thermoforming manufacturer Gujarat. ISO 9001:2015 and ESD CoA per run.

faqs.q: Antistatic thermoformed packaging India — what standard applies?
faqs.a: ESD-safe PP and PETG at 10⁶–10⁹ Ω/sq dissipative range meets ANSI/ESD S541 and IEC 61340-5 packaging material requirements. Specific standard compliance confirmed at brief stage.
Prototype: 7 to 14 business days. MOQ from 500 units. ESD CoA and ISO 9001:2015 per batch.
